plan.title: Auction percentage discount on Sum Total

steps.note: Open the single-stage creation screen for the auction.
a priced single-stage event needs its type set before a template (the screen opens as RFP)
Apply the first available auction pricing template.
Create one controlled line item with quantity 1 so a 100 bid has an expected total of 100 before discount.
Invite the QA vendor needed to submit and revise the bid.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the live auction pricing round in the vendor portal.
Submit the initial bid of 100, establishing the controlled baseline.
Reopen the pricing round so the vendor can revise the live bid.
Select Percentage from the discount mode dropdown.
Enter the requested 10 percent discount; the catalog does not confirm the exact rendered field label.
Verify that the revised current bid total is 90, the expected 10 percent reduction from the controlled baseline of 100.
